# uzc_vm_snapshot (Resource)

Creates a snapshot of a UzCloud virtual machine (POST /virtual-machines/{slug}/snapshots). There is no update endpoint, so changing any attribute recreates the snapshot. The create endpoint queues a job rather than returning the created snapshot, so this resource polls the snapshot list until the new snapshot appears. Use uzc_vm_snapshot_revert to roll a VM back to a snapshot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_vm_snapshot" "example" {
  name            = "example-snapshot"
  virtual_machine = uzc_virtual_machine.example.slug
  cloud_provider  = "nimbo"
  plan            = "snapshot-per-gb"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `plan` (String) Plan slug (e.g. based on the amount of storage used).
- `virtual_machine` (String) Slug of the virtual machine to snapshot.

### Optional

- `billing_cycle` (String) Billing cycle slug. Defaults to "hourly": snapshots and backups are billed by usage, the API rejects monthly and yearly cycles for them, and the provider-level `billing_cycle` default is therefore not used.
- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider slug. Falls back to the provider's `cloud_provider` default when unset.
- `is_memory` (Boolean) Whether to include memory state in the snapshot.
- `project` (String) Project slug. Falls back to the provider's `project` default when unset.
- `region` (String) Region slug. Falls back to the provider's `region` default when unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`. Used as the Terraform resource ID.
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned slug, used for import and by uzc_vm_snapshot_revert.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_vm_snapshot.example <vm-snapshot-slug>
```
